Subject: SOC 2: encryption / KMS evidence request

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 assessment and SIG review, we need a compact package of encryption and KMS evidence from Redwood. Can you provide the following artifacts (redacted as needed) and confirm delivery method?

- HSM attestation (FIPS level & vendor statement) or equivalent attestation PDF
- KMS access matrix (who has key wrap/unwrap and ACLs) for service and ops principals
- Key rotation schedule and most recent rotation logs for master keys (last 12 months)
- Example of envelope encryption configuration for object storage (S3)
- TLS/transit certificate renewal cadence and cert authority details
- 90-day sampling of transit and key-usage logs (redacted) or guidance on how to access them

Requested delivery: ideally by EOD Dec 5 to our secure share. If there are any items that require an MSA/NDAs or special transfer steps, flag them and we can work with procurement.

We may request a short attestation email from your security lead after we review. Thanks — if you prefer a quick call I can make time tomorrow.

Best,
Elena Martinez
